name: DescribeNASFileSystems

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) operation to query the regions where Elastic Desktop Service (EDS) is available
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the office network
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

- Maximum value: 100.

- Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。    

- 最大值：100。    
- 默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of `NextToken`
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the NAS file systems
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return only NAS file systems that are compatible with User Profile Management (UPM)
parameters.help_zh: 是否在查询结果中仅包含只支持UPM的NAS文件系统
parameters.name: match_compatible_profile
